facts.business: Ganesh Benzoplast Limited is one of India's leading independent providers of liquid storage tank infrastructure, specialising in the safe storage and handling of bulk liquid chemicals and petroleum products, with operations across three strategic port locations and diversified presence in engineering and construction, rail logistics, specialty chemical manufacturing, and clean energy.
